title: Machine learning derives bile acid panels for acute and severe acute pancreatitis
summary: In a multicentre cohort (n = 948) with targeted quantification of 63 bile acids, random forest importance ranking and LASSO regression selected a 9-bile-acid diagnostic panel and a 13-bile-acid panel for severe disease. The diagnostic panel gave combined AUC 0.956 for pancreatitis versus controls and 0.890 versus acute cholangitis; the severe-disease panel reached AUC 0.936 in discovery and 0.918 externally. The study is observational and the external set comes from sub-centres of the same network.
ai_technology: Random forest importance ranking and LASSO regression for bile acid panel selection
organization: Affiliated Hospital of North Sichuan Medical College; First Affiliated Hospital of Dalian Medical University

evidence.tested: Discovery, internal and external validation sets in 948 participants (317 pancreatitis, 53 cholangitis, 578 controls); discovery metabolomics on 126 participants.
evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical utility; some severe-disease combined metrics were only partly read.

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
